name: Diffusion MR — one display set for each b-value
notes: Without this rule, a DWI series is one display set, and the viewer can show
it as 4D, with one dimension group for each b-value. This rule puts each
b-value of the series into its own display set, with the description
`isDiffusion` is true when one instance of the series has a b-value above
0. Some scanners write DiffusionBValue = 0 into every MR series, so a
series of b=0 images only is not a diffusion series.
The rule reads the standard DiffusionBValue (0018,9087) only. Images
without a b-value (for example a trace or ADC set) go to the default
`mixedDimensionalityBValue` rule, and form one more display set.
Priority -1: the rule runs before every default rule.
